CustomField.description: MEDIUM-confidence threshold for the top-level extraction 'confidence' score (0-1); values below this band as LOW (Lead.Parse_Confidence__c). Replaces LLMExtractionParser.CONFIDENCE_MEDIUM_MIN (0.60). Also governs the per-field low-confidence signal: a field's own confidence below this value counts toward the Lead's low-confidence field count. Does NOT affect the ExtractAddressQueueable suppression hard gate — that reads only Confidence_High_Min__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 0-1. Below this = LOW confidence band; also the per-field low-confidence threshold (WS7).
CustomField.label: Confidence Medium Min
